practice.hi: ट्रैफ़िक का विश्लेषण करने के बाद, हमने मैलवेयर का C2 सर्वर पहचान लिया।
practice.feedback_en: After + -ing, and the main subject must be the analyser, not the C2 server.
practice.feedback_hi: After + -ing, और मुख्य कर्ता विश्लेषण करने वाला होना चाहिए, C2 सर्वर नहीं।

production.task_en: Rewrite 3 sentences from a recent report or email using participle clauses: one starting with -ing, one with a past participle, one with 'Having'.
production.task_hi: हाल की किसी रिपोर्ट या ईमेल के 3 वाक्यों को participle clause से दोबारा लिखें: एक -ing से शुरू, एक तीसरे रूप से, एक 'Having' से।

title: Cleft sentences and fronting
concept_en: Cleft sentences split one idea into two parts to put the spotlight on one element. It-cleft: 'It was the config file that caused the outage' (not the code). Wh-cleft: 'What we need is a rollback plan', 'What the attacker did was disable logging'. Other fronting: 'The reason (why) we failed is that…', 'The thing I like about this tool is…', 'All I want is a stable build'. These are common in spoken English for emphasis and in reports to state root causes and priorities precisely. Note the verb agreement: 'What we need IS a plan' (singular), and after a wh-cleft the verb can be a bare infinitive: 'What she did was (to) restart the node'.
concept_hi: Cleft sentence एक विचार को दो हिस्सों में बाँटकर किसी एक तत्व पर ज़ोर देते हैं। It-cleft: 'It was the config file that caused the outage' (कोड नहीं)। Wh-cleft: 'What we need is a rollback plan', 'What the attacker did was disable logging'। अन्य fronting: 'The reason (why) we failed is that…', 'The thing I like about this tool is…', 'All I want is a stable build'। ये बोलचाल में ज़ोर देने के लिए और रिपोर्ट में मूल कारण और प्राथमिकताएँ स्पष्ट बताने के लिए आम हैं। क्रिया का मेल ध्यान रखें: 'What we need IS a plan' (एकवचन), और wh-cleft के बाद क्रिया का पहला रूप आ सकता है: 'What she did was (to) restart the node'।
pattern: It + be + X + that/who + rest | What + clause + be + X | What + S + do/did + be + (to) V1 | The reason (why)… is that… | The thing/place/person… is… | All + S + V + be + X

examples.en: It was the expired certificate that broke the login page, not the deploy.
examples.hi: लॉगिन पेज एक्सपायर हुए सर्टिफ़िकेट की वजह से टूटा था, डिप्लॉय की वजह से नहीं।

examples.en: It's Priya who owns the incident process.
examples.hi: इंसिडेंट प्रक्रिया की मालिक प्रिया है।

examples.en: What we need is a clear escalation path.
examples.hi: हमें जो चाहिए वह है स्पष्ट escalation रास्ता।

examples.en: What the attacker did was disable the audit logs.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने जो किया वह था ऑडिट लॉग बंद करना।

examples.en: The reason the fix failed is that the cache was never cleared.
examples.hi: सुधार इसलिए विफल हुआ क्योंकि कैश कभी साफ़ नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: All I'm asking for is a second reviewer.
examples.hi: मैं बस एक दूसरा समीक्षक माँग रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The thing that worries me is the lack of backups.
examples.hi: जो बात मुझे चिंता में डालती है, वह है बैकअप की कमी।

examples.en: It wasn't until the second alert that anyone responded.
examples.hi: दूसरे अलर्ट तक किसी ने जवाब नहीं दिया।

examples.en: What I'd suggest is running the scan overnight.
examples.hi: मेरा सुझाव है कि स्कैन रात भर चलाया जाए।

examples.en: The place where it all went wrong was the load balancer.
examples.hi: जहाँ सब कुछ गलत हुआ, वह था लोड बैलेंसर।

contrast.wrong: What we need are a plan.
contrast.right: What we need is a plan.
contrast.why_en: The wh-clause is treated as singular; the verb agrees with 'what', not with the noun after it (unless that noun is plural: 'What we need are more people').
contrast.why_hi: wh-clause एकवचन माना जाता है; क्रिया 'what' से मेल खाती है (जब तक बाद की संज्ञा बहुवचन न हो: 'What we need are more people')।

contrast.wrong: It was the config that it caused the outage.
contrast.right: It was the config that caused the outage.
contrast.why_en: Do not repeat the subject with 'it' after 'that'. Hindi 'वही था जिसने…' can tempt a double subject.
contrast.why_hi: 'that' के बाद कर्ता को 'it' से दोबारा न दोहराएँ।

contrast.wrong: The reason we failed is because we rushed.
contrast.right: The reason we failed is that we rushed.
contrast.why_en: 'The reason … is because' doubles the cause. Formal English uses 'is that'.
contrast.why_hi: 'The reason … is because' में कारण दो बार आता है। औपचारिक अंग्रेज़ी में 'is that'।

contrast.wrong: It is me which found the bug.
contrast.right: It was I who found the bug. / It was me who found the bug.
contrast.why_en: For people use 'who'; and match the tense ('was' for a past discovery).
contrast.why_hi: लोगों के लिए 'who'; और काल मिलाएँ (अतीत की खोज के लिए 'was')।

practice.prompt: Put the words in order to emphasise the cause.
answer: It was the firewall rule that blocked the traffic.
practice.hi: ट्रैफ़िक फ़ायरवॉल नियम की वजह से ब्लॉक हुआ था।
practice.feedback_hi: It-cleft: It was X that …

practice.prompt: ___ we need most is better monitoring.
practice.hi: हमें सबसे ज़्यादा जो चाहिए वह है बेहतर मॉनिटरिंग।
practice.feedback_hi: Wh-cleft: What + clause + is …

practice.prompt: The reason the site crashed was because of the traffic spike.
answer: The reason the site crashed was the traffic spike.
The reason the site crashed was that traffic spiked.
The site crashed because of the traffic spike.
practice.hi: साइट ट्रैफ़िक बढ़ने की वजह से क्रैश हुई।
practice.feedback_hi: 'The reason … was' + संज्ञा/that-clause, 'because' नहीं।

practice.prompt: What the intern did ___ delete the wrong branch.
practice.hi: इंटर्न ने जो किया वह था गलत ब्रांच मिटाना।
practice.feedback_hi: What + कर्ता + did + was + (to) क्रिया।

practice.prompt: It was the vendor which leaked the data, not us.
answer: It was the vendor that leaked the data, not us.
It was the vendor who leaked the data, not us.
practice.hi: डेटा वेंडर ने लीक किया, हमने नहीं।
practice.feedback_en: In it-clefts use 'that' (or 'who' for people/organisations), not 'which'.
practice.feedback_hi: It-cleft में 'that' (लोगों/संस्थाओं के लिए 'who'), 'which' नहीं।

practice.prompt: 'All I want is five minutes of your time' is a correct cleft-style sentence.
practice.hi: 'All I want is five minutes of your time' सही है?
practice.feedback_hi: सही: All + clause + is + X।

practice.prompt: It ___ until the audit ___ we discovered the shared password.
practice.hi: ऑडिट तक हमें साझा पासवर्ड का पता नहीं चला।
practice.feedback_hi: It wasn't until … that …

practice.prompt: The thing ___ bothers me is the missing changelog.
practice.hi: जो बात मुझे परेशान करती है, वह है गायब changelog।
practice.feedback_hi: The thing that/which + क्रिया …

practice.prompt: What matters are the customer's trust.
answer: What matters is the customer's trust.
practice.hi: जो मायने रखता है, वह है ग्राहक का भरोसा।
practice.feedback_en: Singular 'is' after a wh-clause with a singular complement.
practice.feedback_hi: wh-clause के बाद एकवचन complement हो तो 'is'।

practice.prompt: Rewrite for emphasis: 'Rahul found the exploit.' →
options: It was Rahul who found the exploit.
It was Rahul which found the exploit.
It is Rahul who find the exploit.
Rahul it was found the exploit.
answer: It was Rahul who found the exploit.
practice.hi: एक्सप्लॉइट राहुल ने ढूँढा।
practice.feedback_en: It was + person + who + past verb.
practice.feedback_hi: It was + व्यक्ति + who + अतीत क्रिया।

production.task_en: Write 3 cleft sentences about a project or incident: one 'It was X that…', one 'What we need is…', and one 'The reason … is that…'.
production.task_hi: किसी प्रोजेक्ट या घटना पर 3 cleft वाक्य लिखें: एक 'It was X that…', एक 'What we need is…', और एक 'The reason … is that…'।

title: Hedging and certainty in professional writing
concept_en: In a security report you must say exactly how sure you are. Hedging language softens a claim you cannot fully prove: 'appears to', 'seems to', 'suggests that', 'may/might/could indicate', 'is likely to', 'in most cases', 'to our knowledge', 'we were unable to confirm'. Strong language states what you verified: 'we confirmed', 'this demonstrates', 'is exploitable', 'will'. Mixing them wrongly is dangerous: overclaiming ('the attacker stole all data') when you only saw one file, or underclaiming ('might possibly be an issue') for a verified critical bug. Build a ladder: confirmed → highly likely → likely → possible → cannot rule out. Hindi speakers tend to overuse 'may be' and 'might be' as a politeness habit, which makes verified findings sound uncertain.
concept_hi: सिक्योरिटी रिपोर्ट में आपको बताना होता है कि आप कितने निश्चित हैं। Hedging भाषा उस दावे को नरम करती है जिसे आप पूरी तरह साबित नहीं कर सकते: 'appears to', 'seems to', 'suggests that', 'may/might/could indicate', 'is likely to', 'in most cases', 'to our knowledge', 'we were unable to confirm'। मज़बूत भाषा वह बताती है जो आपने सत्यापित किया: 'we confirmed', 'this demonstrates', 'is exploitable', 'will'। गलत मिश्रण ख़तरनाक है: एक फ़ाइल देखकर 'the attacker stole all data' कहना, या सत्यापित गंभीर बग को 'might possibly be an issue' कहना। सीढ़ी बनाएँ: confirmed → highly likely → likely → possible → cannot rule out। हिंदी भाषी विनम्रता की आदत से 'may be'/'might be' ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल करते हैं, जिससे पक्के निष्कर्ष भी अनिश्चित लगते हैं।
pattern: Confirmed: we confirmed / verified / demonstrated that… | Strong: is likely to / almost certainly / strongly suggests | Medium: appears to / seems to / suggests that / probably | Weak: may / might / could indicate / possibly / cannot be ruled out | Limits: to our knowledge / within the scope of this test / we were unable to…

examples.en: We confirmed that the endpoint returns customer records without authentication.
examples.hi: हमने पुष्टि की कि endpoint बिना प्रमाणीकरण के ग्राहक रिकॉर्ड लौटाता है।

examples.en: The timestamps suggest that the account was accessed from two locations at once.
examples.hi: समय-चिह्न संकेत देते हैं कि खाते को एक साथ दो जगहों से एक्सेस किया गया।

examples.en: This behaviour appears to be caused by a race condition in the session handler.
examples.hi: यह व्यवहार सेशन हैंडलर की रेस कंडीशन के कारण प्रतीत होता है।

examples.en: The exposed key may have been used by third parties; we found no evidence either way.
examples.hi: उजागर key का तीसरे पक्षों ने इस्तेमाल किया हो सकता है; हमें किसी भी दिशा में सबूत नहीं मिला।

examples.en: It is highly likely that the same flaw exists in the mobile client.
examples.hi: बहुत संभव है कि यही खामी मोबाइल क्लाइंट में भी हो।

examples.en: Data exfiltration cannot be ruled out.
examples.hi: डेटा चोरी की संभावना को खारिज नहीं किया जा सकता।

examples.en: To our knowledge, this issue has not been exploited in the wild.
examples.hi: हमारी जानकारी के अनुसार, इस समस्या का वास्तविक हमलों में उपयोग नहीं हुआ है।

examples.en: Within the scope of this assessment, no SQL injection was found.
examples.hi: इस मूल्यांकन के दायरे में, कोई SQL injection नहीं मिला।
examples.note: Says what was tested, not that none exists.

examples.en: The finding is almost certainly exploitable by an unauthenticated attacker.
examples.hi: यह खामी लगभग निश्चित रूप से बिना प्रमाणीकरण वाले हमलावर द्वारा एक्सप्लॉइट की जा सकती है।

examples.en: We were unable to reproduce the crash on version 4.2.
examples.hi: हम संस्करण 4.2 पर क्रैश को दोहरा नहीं सके।

contrast.wrong: The bug may be exploitable. (after you exploited it yourself)
contrast.right: The bug is exploitable; we demonstrated it by retrieving the admin token.
contrast.why_en: Do not hedge what you have proven. It weakens the report and delays the fix. The Hindi habit of softening ('हो सकता है') for politeness does not belong in findings.
contrast.why_hi: जो साबित कर दिया, उसे नरम न करें। इससे रिपोर्ट कमज़ोर होती है और सुधार में देरी। विनम्रता के लिए 'हो सकता है' कहने की हिंदी आदत निष्कर्षों में नहीं चलती।

contrast.wrong: The attacker stole the entire database. (you saw one exported table)
contrast.right: At least one table was exported; further exfiltration is likely but unconfirmed.
contrast.why_en: State what you saw, then your assessment, separately.
contrast.why_hi: जो देखा वह बताएँ, फिर अपना आकलन अलग से।

contrast.wrong: There is no SQL injection in the application.
contrast.right: No SQL injection was identified within the tested scope.
contrast.why_en: You cannot prove absence; limit the claim to what was tested.
contrast.why_hi: अनुपस्थिति साबित नहीं की जा सकती; दावे को परखे गए दायरे तक सीमित रखें।

contrast.wrong: It might possibly perhaps be a problem.
contrast.right: It could be a problem.
contrast.why_en: One hedge is enough. Stacking them sounds evasive.
contrast.why_hi: एक hedge काफ़ी है। कई जोड़ने से टालमटोल लगता है।

practice.prompt: You retrieved another user's data using the flaw. Best wording:
options: The endpoint may expose user data.
The endpoint exposes user data; we retrieved another user's profile.
It is possible that the endpoint could expose data.
The endpoint might possibly leak data.
answer: The endpoint exposes user data; we retrieved another user's profile.
practice.hi: आपने खामी से दूसरे उपयोगकर्ता का डेटा निकाला। सबसे सही वाक्य?
practice.feedback_en: Verified → state it directly with the evidence.
practice.feedback_hi: सत्यापित → सबूत के साथ सीधे कहें।

practice.prompt: The log pattern ___ (suggest) that the scan came from an internal host, though we could not verify it.
practice.hi: लॉग पैटर्न संकेत देता है कि स्कैन आंतरिक होस्ट से आया, हालाँकि हम सत्यापित नहीं कर सके।
practice.feedback_hi: सबूत-आधारित अनुमान → 'suggests'।

practice.prompt: There are no vulnerabilities in the API.
answer: No vulnerabilities were identified in the API within the tested scope.
No vulnerabilities were found in the API within the scope of this test.
practice.hi: परखे गए दायरे में API में कोई खामी नहीं मिली।
practice.feedback_en: Limit the claim to what you tested.
practice.feedback_hi: दावे को परखे गए दायरे तक सीमित रखें।

practice.prompt: You found an old exposed key but no sign it was used. Best wording:
options: The key may have been abused; we found no evidence of use.
The key might possibly perhaps have been abused.
answer: The key may have been abused; we found no evidence of use.
practice.hi: पुरानी उजागर key मिली पर उपयोग का कोई निशान नहीं। सबसे सही?
practice.feedback_en: Weak hedge plus an explicit statement of what you found.
practice.feedback_hi: हल्का hedge और साथ में स्पष्ट बताएँ कि क्या मिला।

practice.prompt: 'Data exfiltration cannot be ruled out' means exfiltration definitely happened.
practice.hi: 'Data exfiltration cannot be ruled out' का मतलब है कि डेटा चोरी पक्का हुई?
practice.feedback_en: False. It means it is possible and has not been disproved.
practice.feedback_hi: गलत। इसका मतलब है संभव है और खारिज नहीं हुआ।

practice.prompt: Put the words in order.
answer: It is highly likely that the password was reused.
practice.hi: बहुत संभव है कि पासवर्ड दोबारा इस्तेमाल किया गया था।
practice.feedback_en: It is highly likely that + clause.
practice.feedback_hi: It is highly likely that + clause।

practice.prompt: We could not reproduce it, so the bug does not exist.
answer: We could not reproduce the bug; it may depend on conditions we did not test.
We were unable to reproduce the bug within the tested conditions.
practice.hi: हम बग को दोहरा नहीं सके; यह उन परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर हो सकता है जिन्हें हमने परखा नहीं।
practice.feedback_en: Failure to reproduce is not proof of absence.
practice.feedback_hi: दोहरा न पाना अनुपस्थिति का सबूत नहीं है।

practice.prompt: Which phrase is the STRONGEST?
practice.hi: सबसे मज़बूत वाक्यांश कौन-सा है?
practice.feedback_en: A plain present-tense statement is the strongest claim.
practice.feedback_hi: सादा वर्तमान काल का कथन सबसे मज़बूत दावा है।

practice.prompt: ___ our knowledge, no public exploit exists for this CVE.
practice.hi: हमारी जानकारी के अनुसार, इस CVE के लिए कोई सार्वजनिक एक्सप्लॉइट नहीं है।
practice.feedback_en: 'To our knowledge' limits the claim honestly.
practice.feedback_hi: 'To our knowledge' दावे को ईमानदारी से सीमित करता है।

practice.prompt: It seems it appears that the token might maybe be valid.
answer: The token appears to be valid.
It appears that the token is valid.
practice.hi: टोकन वैध प्रतीत होता है।
practice.feedback_hi: सिर्फ़ एक hedge।

production.task_en: Write 3 findings sentences for a security report about one issue: (1) what you confirmed, (2) what the evidence suggests but you could not verify, (3) what cannot be ruled out. Use a different certainty level in each.
production.task_hi: एक समस्या पर सिक्योरिटी रिपोर्ट के 3 वाक्य लिखें: (1) जो आपने पुष्टि की, (2) जो सबूत संकेत देते हैं पर सत्यापित नहीं हुआ, (3) जिसे खारिज नहीं किया जा सकता। हर वाक्य में अलग निश्चितता स्तर रखें।

title: Nominalisation and formal register
concept_en: Nominalisation turns verbs and adjectives into nouns: 'we found' becomes 'our findings', 'the attacker can bypass' becomes 'bypass is possible', 'the server failed' becomes 'the failure of the server'. Formal reports use it to sound objective, to remove 'I/we', and to pack information densely: 'Exploitation of this flaw requires authentication'. It also changes register: 'fix' → 'remediation', 'find out' → 'determine', 'a lot of' → 'a significant number of', 'get' → 'obtain', 'show' → 'demonstrate'. Too much nominalisation makes text heavy and hard to read, so use it for headings, summaries and impact statements, and keep instructions in plain verbs ('Rotate the key').
concept_hi: Nominalisation क्रिया और विशेषण को संज्ञा बनाता है: 'we found' → 'our findings', 'the attacker can bypass' → 'bypass is possible', 'the server failed' → 'the failure of the server'। औपचारिक रिपोर्ट इसे निष्पक्ष दिखने, 'I/we' हटाने और जानकारी घनी रखने के लिए इस्तेमाल करती है: 'Exploitation of this flaw requires authentication'। इससे रजिस्टर भी बदलता है: 'fix' → 'remediation', 'find out' → 'determine', 'a lot of' → 'a significant number of', 'get' → 'obtain', 'show' → 'demonstrate'। बहुत ज़्यादा nominalisation पाठ को भारी बनाता है, इसलिए इसे शीर्षक, सारांश और प्रभाव कथनों में रखें, और निर्देश सादी क्रियाओं में लिखें ('Rotate the key')।
pattern: verb → noun: exploit → exploitation, fail → failure, remediate → remediation, disclose → disclosure, assess → assessment, expose → exposure | adjective → noun: severe → severity, likely → likelihood, able → ability | formal swaps: fix → remediate, get → obtain, show → demonstrate, find out → determine, a lot of → a significant number of, big → substantial

examples.en: We found three critical issues. → Three critical findings were identified.
examples.hi: तीन गंभीर निष्कर्ष पहचाने गए।

examples.en: An attacker can bypass MFA. → MFA bypass is possible for an unauthenticated attacker.
examples.hi: बिना प्रमाणीकरण वाले हमलावर के लिए MFA bypass संभव है।

examples.en: The server failed because the disk was full. → The server failure was caused by disk exhaustion.
examples.hi: सर्वर की विफलता डिस्क भर जाने के कारण हुई।

examples.en: We need to fix this quickly. → Prompt remediation is required.
examples.hi: शीघ्र सुधार आवश्यक है।

examples.en: Exploitation of this vulnerability requires local access.
examples.hi: इस खामी के दोहन के लिए स्थानीय पहुँच आवश्यक है।

examples.en: The likelihood of exploitation is high given the public proof of concept.
examples.hi: सार्वजनिक proof of concept को देखते हुए दोहन की संभावना अधिक है।

examples.en: We told the vendor on 3 May. → Disclosure to the vendor took place on 3 May.
examples.hi: वेंडर को सूचना 3 मई को दी गई।

examples.en: The team showed that the payload works. → The team demonstrated that the payload is effective.
examples.hi: टीम ने प्रदर्शित किया कि पेलोड प्रभावी है।

examples.en: A lot of accounts got compromised. → A significant number of accounts were compromised.
examples.hi: बड़ी संख्या में खाते समझौता-ग्रस्त हुए।

examples.en: Recommendation: rotate all API keys and enforce MFA.
examples.hi: सिफ़ारिश: सभी API keys बदलें और MFA लागू करें।
examples.note: Heading nominalised; instruction stays as plain verbs.

contrast.wrong: We did the testing of the app and found out a lot of bugs.
contrast.right: The assessment of the application identified a significant number of defects.
contrast.why_en: Formal register: 'assessment', 'identified', 'a significant number of', 'defects'. Indian English often keeps 'did the testing' and 'a lot of' in formal documents.
contrast.why_hi: औपचारिक रजिस्टर: 'assessment', 'identified', 'a significant number of', 'defects'। भारतीय अंग्रेज़ी में औपचारिक दस्तावेज़ों में भी 'did the testing' और 'a lot of' रह जाते हैं।

contrast.wrong: The implementation of the utilisation of the rotation of the keys is a necessity.
contrast.right: Keys must be rotated.
contrast.why_en: Over-nominalised. Instructions should be direct verbs.
contrast.why_hi: ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा nominalisation। निर्देश सीधी क्रियाओं में हों।

contrast.wrong: Attacker exploit is very much possible.
contrast.right: Exploitation is highly likely.
contrast.why_en: Use the noun form 'exploitation' and the adverb 'highly'. 'Very much possible' is an Indianism.
contrast.why_hi: संज्ञा रूप 'exploitation' और क्रियाविशेषण 'highly'। 'very much possible' भारतीय प्रयोग है।

contrast.wrong: Kindly do the needful for the fixing of the bug.
contrast.right: Please remediate the issue by 15 June.
contrast.why_en: 'Do the needful' and 'kindly' are Indianisms; be specific and use 'remediate'.
contrast.why_hi: 'do the needful' और 'kindly' भारतीय प्रयोग हैं; स्पष्ट रहें और 'remediate' लगाएँ।

practice.prompt: verb → noun: 'remediate' → ___
practice.hi: 'remediate' की संज्ञा?
practice.feedback_hi: remediation

practice.prompt: adjective → noun: 'severe' → ___
practice.hi: 'severe' की संज्ञा?
practice.feedback_hi: severity

practice.prompt: We found out that a lot of users got phished.
answer: Our investigation determined that a significant number of users were phished.
A significant number of users were found to have been phished.
practice.hi: जाँच से पता चला कि बड़ी संख्या में उपयोगकर्ता फ़िश हुए।
practice.feedback_en: determined / a significant number of / were phished.
practice.feedback_hi: determined / a significant number of / were phished।

practice.prompt: Most formal: 'The attacker can read the file.' →
options: File reading is doable by the attacker.
The attacker is able to do reading of the file.
The attacker can very much read the file.
practice.hi: सबसे औपचारिक विकल्प?
practice.feedback_hi: Nominalised प्रभाव कथन।

practice.prompt: The doing of the rotation of the keys should be carried out by the team.
answer: The team should rotate the keys.
practice.hi: टीम को keys बदलनी चाहिए।
practice.feedback_en: Instructions use plain verbs; remove the nominalisation stack.
practice.feedback_hi: निर्देश सादी क्रिया में; nominalisation का ढेर हटाएँ।

practice.prompt: Formal replacement for 'get':
practice.hi: 'get' का औपचारिक विकल्प?
practice.feedback_hi: obtain

practice.prompt: Put the words in order.
answer: Exploitation of this flaw requires an authenticated session.
practice.hi: इस खामी के दोहन के लिए प्रमाणित सेशन आवश्यक है।
practice.feedback_hi: Nominalised कर्ता + requires + कर्म।

practice.prompt: In a formal report, 'We told the client on Monday' is better written as 'Disclosure to the client occurred on Monday'.
practice.hi: औपचारिक रिपोर्ट में 'We told the client on Monday' से 'Disclosure to the client occurred on Monday' बेहतर है?
practice.feedback_en: True for a timeline section; it removes 'we' and uses the standard noun 'disclosure'.
practice.feedback_hi: समयरेखा खंड के लिए सही; 'we' हटता है और मानक संज्ञा 'disclosure' आती है।

practice.prompt: The chance that someone exploits it is very much high.
answer: The likelihood of exploitation is high.
The likelihood of exploitation is very high.
practice.hi: दोहन की संभावना अधिक है।
practice.feedback_hi: likelihood of exploitation; 'very much' हटाएँ।

practice.prompt: Which is the best formal heading for 'what happens if someone uses this bug'?
practice.hi: 'अगर कोई इस बग का इस्तेमाल करे तो क्या होगा' का सबसे औपचारिक शीर्षक?
practice.feedback_hi: Nominalised शीर्षक: Impact of exploitation।

production.task_en: Take 3 informal sentences from a chat message about a bug (e.g. 'we found a big problem, anyone can get the file, please fix asap') and rewrite each in formal report register using nominalisation.
production.task_hi: किसी बग पर चैट संदेश के 3 अनौपचारिक वाक्य लें (जैसे 'we found a big problem, anyone can get the file, please fix asap') और हर एक को nominalisation के साथ औपचारिक रिपोर्ट रजिस्टर में लिखें।

title: Subjunctive and formal structures
concept_en: The subjunctive is the bare verb used after verbs and adjectives of demand, suggestion and necessity: 'We recommend that the key be rotated', 'It is essential that every user enable MFA', 'She insisted that he not share the file'. There is no -s and no 'to'. Other formal structures you will meet in policies and legal-style text: inverted conditionals ('Should you need assistance, contact…' = If you need; 'Were the server to fail…' = If the server failed; 'Had we known…'), 'lest' ('Back up first, lest data be lost'), and fixed phrases ('be that as it may', 'so be it', 'far be it from me'). Hindi speakers usually add -s or 'to' after 'recommend that', producing 'recommend that he takes' or 'recommend him to take'.
concept_hi: Subjunctive वह मूल क्रिया है जो माँग, सुझाव और आवश्यकता वाली क्रियाओं और विशेषणों के बाद आती है: 'We recommend that the key be rotated', 'It is essential that every user enable MFA', 'She insisted that he not share the file'। न -s, न 'to'। नीतियों और कानूनी शैली में मिलने वाले अन्य औपचारिक ढाँचे: उलटे conditional ('Should you need assistance, contact…' = If you need; 'Were the server to fail…' = If the server failed; 'Had we known…'), 'lest' ('Back up first, lest data be lost'), और तय वाक्यांश ('be that as it may', 'so be it')। हिंदी भाषी 'recommend that' के बाद -s या 'to' जोड़ देते हैं।
pattern: recommend/suggest/insist/demand/request/propose + that + S + V1 (be) | It is essential/vital/important/imperative + that + S + V1 | that + S + not + V1 | Should + S + V1, … (= if) | Were + S + to + V1, … | Had + S + V3, … | lest + S + V1

examples.en: We recommend that the default password be changed before deployment.
examples.hi: हमारी सिफ़ारिश है कि डिप्लॉयमेंट से पहले डिफ़ॉल्ट पासवर्ड बदला जाए।

examples.en: It is essential that each engineer complete the training by Friday.
examples.hi: यह आवश्यक है कि हर इंजीनियर शुक्रवार तक प्रशिक्षण पूरा करे।

examples.en: The client insisted that the report not mention the vendor by name.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट ने ज़ोर दिया कि रिपोर्ट में वेंडर का नाम न हो।

examples.en: Should you have any questions, please contact the security desk.
examples.hi: यदि आपके कोई प्रश्न हों, तो कृपया सिक्योरिटी डेस्क से संपर्क करें।

examples.en: Were the primary database to fail, traffic would switch to the replica.
examples.hi: यदि प्राथमिक डेटाबेस विफल हो जाए, तो ट्रैफ़िक रेप्लिका पर चला जाएगा।

examples.en: Had the patch been applied, the incident would have been avoided.
examples.hi: यदि पैच लगाया गया होता, तो घटना टल जाती।
examples.note: = If the patch had been applied

examples.en: Verify the checksum before installing, lest the package be tampered with.
examples.hi: इंस्टॉल करने से पहले checksum जाँचें, कहीं पैकेज से छेड़छाड़ न हुई हो।

examples.en: The board demanded that the CISO resign.
examples.hi: बोर्ड ने माँग की कि CISO इस्तीफ़ा दे।

examples.en: It is imperative that access logs be retained for one year.
examples.hi: यह अनिवार्य है कि एक्सेस लॉग एक साल तक रखे जाएँ।

examples.en: Be that as it may, the deadline stands.
examples.hi: जो भी हो, समय-सीमा वही रहेगी।

contrast.wrong: We recommend that the admin changes the password.
contrast.right: We recommend that the admin change the password.
contrast.why_en: After 'recommend that', the verb is the bare form. Hindi 'बदले' is a subjunctive too, but learners map it to the English present -s.
contrast.why_hi: 'recommend that' के बाद क्रिया मूल रूप में। हिंदी 'बदले' भी subjunctive है, पर सीखने वाले इसे अंग्रेज़ी -s से जोड़ देते हैं।

contrast.wrong: It is important that he is informed immediately.
contrast.right: It is important that he be informed immediately.
contrast.why_en: Formal English uses 'be' after 'It is important that'.
contrast.why_hi: औपचारिक अंग्रेज़ी में 'It is important that' के बाद 'be'।

contrast.wrong: We suggest him to update the firmware.
contrast.right: We suggest that he update the firmware.
contrast.why_en: 'Suggest' never takes object + to-infinitive.
contrast.why_hi: 'suggest' के बाद व्यक्ति + to + क्रिया नहीं आता।

contrast.wrong: If should you need help, call us.
contrast.right: Should you need help, call us.
contrast.why_en: Inverted 'Should' replaces 'if'; never use both.
contrast.why_hi: उलटा 'Should' 'if' की जगह लेता है; दोनों न लगाएँ।

practice.prompt: We recommend that the certificate ___ (be) renewed automatically.
practice.hi: हमारी सिफ़ारिश है कि सर्टिफ़िकेट स्वतः नवीनीकृत हो।
practice.feedback_hi: Subjunctive: be।

practice.prompt: It is vital that every developer signs their commits.
answer: It is vital that every developer sign their commits.
practice.hi: यह ज़रूरी है कि हर डेवलपर अपने कमिट पर हस्ताक्षर करे।
practice.feedback_en: Bare verb after 'it is vital that'.
practice.feedback_hi: 'it is vital that' के बाद मूल क्रिया।

practice.prompt: The auditor insisted that the logs ___ deleted.
practice.hi: ऑडिटर ने ज़ोर दिया कि लॉग न मिटाए जाएँ।
practice.feedback_hi: नकारात्मक subjunctive: not + be।

practice.prompt: If you should require access, please raise a ticket.
answer: Should you require access, please raise a ticket.
If you require access, please raise a ticket.
practice.hi: यदि आपको पहुँच चाहिए, तो कृपया टिकट बनाएँ।
practice.feedback_en: Either 'If you require' or inverted 'Should you require', not both.
practice.feedback_hi: या 'If you require' या उलटा 'Should you require', दोनों नहीं।

practice.prompt: Put the words in order.
answer: Were the backup link to fail, we would lose connectivity.
practice.hi: यदि बैकअप लिंक विफल हो जाए, तो हमारी कनेक्टिविटी चली जाएगी।
practice.feedback_hi: Were + कर्ता + to + क्रिया, … would …

practice.prompt: 'The policy requires that all devices are encrypted' is the formal subjunctive form.
practice.hi: 'The policy requires that all devices are encrypted' औपचारिक subjunctive है?
practice.feedback_en: False. The subjunctive is 'that all devices be encrypted'.
practice.feedback_hi: गलत। subjunctive है 'that all devices be encrypted'।

practice.prompt: We propose him to lead the incident response.
answer: We propose that he lead the incident response.
practice.hi: हम प्रस्ताव रखते हैं कि वह incident response का नेतृत्व करे।
practice.feedback_hi: propose + that + कर्ता + मूल क्रिया।

practice.prompt: ___ we known about the flaw earlier, we would have disclosed it.
practice.hi: अगर हमें खामी के बारे में पहले पता होता, तो हम उसे उजागर कर देते।
practice.feedback_en: Had + S + V3 = If we had known.
practice.feedback_hi: Had + कर्ता + तीसरा रूप = If we had known।

practice.prompt: Store the recovery codes offline, ___ they be exposed in a breach.
practice.hi: रिकवरी कोड ऑफ़लाइन रखें, कहीं सेंधमारी में वे उजागर न हो जाएँ।
practice.feedback_hi: lest + subjunctive।

practice.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: It is essential that she attends.
It is essential that she attend.
It is essential that she to attend.
It is essential that she will attend.
answer: It is essential that she attend.
practice.hi: कौन-सा वाक्य सही है?
practice.feedback_hi: मूल क्रिया 'attend'।

production.task_en: Write 3 recommendation sentences for a security report using the subjunctive (e.g. 'We recommend that…', 'It is essential that…') and one 'Should you…' sentence for the closing paragraph.
production.task_hi: सिक्योरिटी रिपोर्ट के लिए subjunctive में 3 सिफ़ारिश वाक्य लिखें (जैसे 'We recommend that…', 'It is essential that…') और समापन के लिए एक 'Should you…' वाक्य।

title: Ellipsis, substitution and cohesion
concept_en: Native writing avoids repeating words. Ellipsis leaves words out when they are understood: 'I can fix it and (I) will (fix it)'. Substitution replaces a word with a stand-in: 'one/ones' for countable nouns ('the old server and the new one'), 'do/do so/did' for verb phrases ('They asked us to retest, and we did so'), 'so/not' after think/hope/expect/afraid ('I think so', 'I hope not'). Reference words (this, that, these, such, the former, the latter, respectively) point back to earlier ideas. Hindi speakers tend to repeat the full noun or verb phrase, which sounds mechanical, or to over-use 'the same' as a pronoun ('Please find the same attached'). Cohesion means these links are clear and never ambiguous.
concept_hi: देशी लेखन शब्द दोहराने से बचता है। Ellipsis समझे हुए शब्द छोड़ देता है: 'I can fix it and (I) will (fix it)'। Substitution शब्द की जगह स्थानापन्न रखता है: गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए 'one/ones' ('the old server and the new one'), क्रिया-समूह के लिए 'do/do so/did' ('They asked us to retest, and we did so'), think/hope/expect/afraid के बाद 'so/not' ('I think so', 'I hope not')। संदर्भ शब्द (this, that, these, such, the former, the latter, respectively) पहले के विचारों की ओर इशारा करते हैं। हिंदी भाषी पूरी संज्ञा या क्रिया दोहराते हैं, जो यांत्रिक लगता है, या 'the same' को सर्वनाम की तरह ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल करते हैं ('Please find the same attached')। Cohesion का मतलब है ये कड़ियाँ स्पष्ट और असंदिग्ध हों।
pattern: Ellipsis: S + aux (+ not) — 'She can, I can't' | one/ones = countable noun | do (so) / did = verb phrase | think/hope/expect/be afraid + so / not | this/that/such + noun = earlier idea | the former … the latter | X and Y … respectively

examples.en: We tested the API, and the mobile team tested the app. Both passed.
examples.hi: हमने API टेस्ट किया, और मोबाइल टीम ने ऐप। दोनों पास हुए।
examples.note: 'Both' refers back; no repetition of 'the API and the app'.

examples.en: Is the fix ready? I think so, but I'm not sure.
examples.hi: क्या फ़िक्स तैयार है? मुझे लगता है हाँ, पर पक्का नहीं।

examples.en: Will the outage affect payments? I hope not.
examples.hi: क्या आउटेज भुगतान पर असर डालेगा? उम्मीद है नहीं।

examples.en: The old cluster is slow; the new one is much faster.
examples.hi: पुराना क्लस्टर धीमा है; नया कहीं तेज़ है।

examples.en: They asked us to retest after the patch, and we did so on Tuesday.
examples.hi: उन्होंने पैच के बाद दोबारा टेस्ट करने को कहा, और हमने मंगलवार को किया।

examples.en: She can reproduce the crash, but I can't.
examples.hi: वह क्रैश को दोहरा सकती है, पर मैं नहीं।

examples.en: Both SQL injection and XSS were found; the former is critical, the latter medium.
examples.hi: SQL injection और XSS दोनों मिले; पहला गंभीर है, दूसरा मध्यम।

examples.en: Alice and Bob own the backend and the frontend respectively.
examples.hi: एलिस और बॉब क्रमशः बैकएंड और फ़्रंटएंड के मालिक हैं।

examples.en: The token never expires. This means a stolen token is valid forever.
examples.hi: टोकन कभी एक्सपायर नहीं होता। इसका मतलब है कि चुराया गया टोकन हमेशा वैध रहता है।

examples.en: Such behaviour is typical of credential-stuffing attacks.
examples.hi: ऐसा व्यवहार credential-stuffing हमलों की खासियत है।

contrast.wrong: Please find attached the report and revert on the same.
contrast.right: Please find the report attached and let me know your comments.
contrast.why_en: 'The same' as a pronoun and 'revert' (= reply) are Indianisms. Use 'it' or rephrase.
contrast.why_hi: सर्वनाम के रूप में 'the same' और 'revert' (= जवाब देना) भारतीय प्रयोग हैं। 'it' लगाएँ या दोबारा लिखें।

contrast.wrong: I bought a new laptop because my old laptop was slow.
contrast.right: I bought a new laptop because my old one was slow.
contrast.why_en: Substitute the repeated noun with 'one'.
contrast.why_hi: दोहराई गई संज्ञा की जगह 'one'।

contrast.wrong: Do you think the client will accept? — I think.
contrast.right: Do you think the client will accept? — I think so.
contrast.why_en: 'Think' needs 'so' or 'not' when the object is left out. Hindi 'मुझे लगता है' stands alone; English cannot.
contrast.why_hi: कर्म छोड़ने पर 'think' के बाद 'so' या 'not' चाहिए। हिंदी 'मुझे लगता है' अकेला खड़ा रह सकता है; अंग्रेज़ी नहीं।

contrast.wrong: The developers fixed the bug, and the testers also fixed the bug.
contrast.right: The developers fixed the bug, and so did the testers. / …and the testers did too.
contrast.why_en: Use 'so did' / 'did too' instead of repeating the verb phrase.
contrast.why_hi: क्रिया-समूह दोहराने के बजाय 'so did' / 'did too'।

practice.prompt: The staging server is patched, but the production server is not patched.
answer: The staging server is patched, but the production one is not.
The staging server is patched, but the production server isn't.
practice.hi: स्टेजिंग सर्वर पैच है, पर प्रोडक्शन वाला नहीं।
practice.feedback_en: Substitute with 'one' and/or use ellipsis after 'is not'.
practice.feedback_hi: 'one' से स्थानापन्न करें और/या 'is not' के बाद ellipsis।

practice.prompt: Will the vendor patch it this week? — I hope ___.
practice.hi: क्या वेंडर इस हफ़्ते पैच करेगा? — उम्मीद है हाँ।
practice.feedback_hi: hope + so।

practice.prompt: Is the data recoverable? — I'm afraid ___.
practice.hi: क्या डेटा वापस मिल सकता है? — मुझे डर है नहीं।
practice.feedback_hi: be afraid + not।

practice.prompt: We asked them to rotate the keys, and they ___ immediately.
practice.hi: हमने उनसे keys बदलने को कहा, और उन्होंने तुरंत किया।
practice.feedback_en: do so = the action just mentioned.
practice.feedback_hi: do so = अभी बताई गई क्रिया।

practice.prompt: Kindly check the attached file and revert on the same.
answer: Please check the attached file and let me know.
Please review the attached file and send me your comments.
practice.hi: कृपया संलग्न फ़ाइल देखें और मुझे बताएँ।
practice.feedback_hi: 'kindly', 'revert' और 'the same' बदलें।

practice.prompt: Two issues were found: an open port and a weak cipher. ___ was closed within an hour; ___ is still pending.
practice.hi: दो समस्याएँ मिलीं: खुला पोर्ट और कमज़ोर cipher। पहली एक घंटे में बंद हुई; दूसरी अभी बाकी है।
practice.feedback_en: the former = first mentioned; the latter = second.
practice.feedback_hi: the former = पहले बताया; the latter = दूसरा।

practice.prompt: Put the words in order.
answer: She can read the logs, but I can't.
practice.hi: वह लॉग पढ़ सकती है, पर मैं नहीं।
practice.feedback_hi: Ellipsis: 'I can't' (read the logs)।

practice.prompt: 'The API and the web app were tested by Riya and Amit respectively' means Riya tested the API.
practice.hi: '…by Riya and Amit respectively' का मतलब है रिया ने API टेस्ट किया?
practice.feedback_en: True: 'respectively' matches the items in order.
practice.feedback_hi: सही: 'respectively' क्रम से मिलान करता है।

practice.prompt: The devs deployed the fix, and the ops team also deployed the fix.
answer: The devs deployed the fix, and so did the ops team.
The devs deployed the fix, and the ops team did too.
practice.hi: डेवलपर्स ने फ़िक्स डिप्लॉय किया, और ऑप्स टीम ने भी।
practice.feedback_hi: so did / did too।

practice.prompt: The session cookie lacks the Secure flag. ___ allows it to be sent over HTTP.
practice.hi: सेशन कुकी में Secure फ़्लैग नहीं है। इससे वह HTTP पर भेजी जा सकती है।
practice.feedback_en: 'This' refers back to the whole previous statement.
practice.feedback_hi: 'This' पूरे पिछले कथन की ओर इशारा करता है।

production.task_en: Write a 4-sentence paragraph about two tools you use, without repeating any noun or verb phrase: use 'one', 'so/not', 'did so' or 'the former/the latter' at least once each.
production.task_hi: अपने दो टूल्स पर 4 वाक्यों का अनुच्छेद लिखें, कोई संज्ञा या क्रिया-समूह दोहराए बिना: 'one', 'so/not', 'did so' या 'the former/the latter' में से हर एक कम से कम एक बार।

title: Sentence structure and punctuation for reports
concept_en: Clear reports depend on three things. First, avoid run-ons and comma splices: two full sentences cannot be joined by a comma alone ('The port was open, we closed it' ✗). Use a full stop, a semicolon, or a conjunction. Second, avoid fragments: every sentence needs a subject and a finite verb ('Because the cache was stale.' ✗ on its own). Third, use punctuation with purpose: a colon introduces a list or explanation ('Three hosts were affected: web01, web02 and db01'), a semicolon joins two closely related sentences, and items in a list must be parallel (all nouns, or all verbs in the same form). Bullet points in a report should each start the same way. Hindi speakers often write very long sentences joined by commas and 'and', because Hindi prose does that naturally; English prefers shorter sentences.
concept_hi: स्पष्ट रिपोर्ट तीन बातों पर टिकी है। पहली, run-on और comma splice से बचें: दो पूरे वाक्य सिर्फ़ कॉमा से नहीं जुड़ सकते ('The port was open, we closed it' ✗)। full stop, semicolon या conjunction लगाएँ। दूसरी, fragment से बचें: हर वाक्य में कर्ता और finite क्रिया चाहिए ('Because the cache was stale.' अकेले ✗)। तीसरी, विराम-चिह्न उद्देश्य से लगाएँ: colon सूची या व्याख्या शुरू करता है ('Three hosts were affected: web01, web02 and db01'), semicolon दो निकट संबंधित वाक्य जोड़ता है, और सूची के आइटम समानांतर हों (सब संज्ञा, या सब एक ही रूप की क्रिया)। रिपोर्ट के bullet points एक जैसे शुरू हों। हिंदी भाषी अक्सर कॉमा और 'and' से जुड़े बहुत लंबे वाक्य लिखते हैं क्योंकि हिंदी गद्य में यह स्वाभाविक है; अंग्रेज़ी छोटे वाक्य पसंद करती है।
pattern: Sentence. Sentence. | Sentence; sentence. | Sentence, and/but/so sentence. | Intro clause: list / explanation | Parallel list: to X, to Y, and to Z / Xing, Ying, Zing | Fragment fix: attach to a main clause

examples.en: The port was open. We closed it within an hour.
examples.hi: पोर्ट खुला था। हमने उसे एक घंटे में बंद कर दिया।
examples.note: Two sentences, not a comma splice.

examples.en: The port was open; we closed it within an hour.
examples.hi: पोर्ट खुला था; हमने उसे एक घंटे में बंद कर दिया।
examples.note: Semicolon joins two closely related sentences.

examples.en: The port was open, so we closed it within an hour.
examples.hi: पोर्ट खुला था, इसलिए हमने उसे एक घंटे में बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: Three hosts were affected: web01, web02 and db01.
examples.hi: तीन होस्ट प्रभावित हुए: web01, web02 और db01।

examples.en: The root cause was simple: the certificate had expired.
examples.hi: मूल कारण सरल था: सर्टिफ़िकेट की अवधि समाप्त हो गई थी।

examples.en: We recommend rotating the keys, enabling MFA, and reviewing access logs weekly.
examples.hi: हम keys बदलने, MFA चालू करने और साप्ताहिक एक्सेस लॉग समीक्षा की सिफ़ारिश करते हैं।

examples.en: The service crashed because the cache was stale.
examples.hi: सेवा इसलिए क्रैश हुई क्योंकि कैश पुराना था।
examples.note: 'Because' clause attached to a main clause, not left alone.

examples.en: Impact: an unauthenticated attacker can read any user's invoices.
examples.hi: प्रभाव: बिना प्रमाणीकरण वाला हमलावर किसी भी उपयोगकर्ता के इनवॉइस पढ़ सकता है।

examples.en: Although the fix was small, it required a full regression run.
examples.hi: हालाँकि सुधार छोटा था, इसके लिए पूरा regression run चाहिए था।

examples.en: Steps to reproduce: 1. Log in as a standard user. 2. Open /admin/export. 3. Observe that all records are returned.
examples.hi: दोहराने के चरण: 1. सामान्य उपयोगकर्ता के रूप में लॉगिन करें। 2. /admin/export खोलें। 3. देखें कि सभी रिकॉर्ड लौटते हैं।
examples.note: Each step is an imperative sentence.

contrast.wrong: The server was compromised, the attacker installed a web shell.
contrast.right: The server was compromised; the attacker installed a web shell. / The server was compromised, and the attacker installed a web shell.
contrast.why_en: Comma splice. Two independent clauses need a semicolon, full stop or conjunction. Hindi writing chains clauses with commas freely.
contrast.why_hi: Comma splice। दो स्वतंत्र clause के बीच semicolon, full stop या conjunction चाहिए। हिंदी लेखन में clause कॉमा से जुड़ते रहते हैं।

contrast.wrong: Which allowed the attacker to escalate privileges.
contrast.right: This allowed the attacker to escalate privileges.
contrast.why_en: A 'which' clause on its own is a fragment. Start with 'This' to make a full sentence.
contrast.why_hi: अकेला 'which' clause fragment है। पूरा वाक्य बनाने के लिए 'This' से शुरू करें।

contrast.wrong: The team should: rotate keys, MFA enabled, and reviewing logs.
contrast.right: The team should rotate keys, enable MFA, and review logs.
contrast.why_en: List items must be parallel (all bare verbs here). Also, no colon directly after 'should'.
contrast.why_hi: सूची के आइटम समानांतर हों (यहाँ सब मूल क्रिया)। 'should' के ठीक बाद colon भी नहीं।

contrast.wrong: We found the bug and we fixed it and we tested it and then we deployed it and it worked.
contrast.right: We found the bug, fixed it and tested it. We then deployed it, and it worked.
contrast.why_en: Break the chain of 'and'. Use shorter sentences and a shared subject.
contrast.why_hi: 'and' की श्रृंखला तोड़ें। छोटे वाक्य और साझा कर्ता इस्तेमाल करें।

practice.prompt: The backup failed, nobody was alerted.
answer: The backup failed; nobody was alerted.
The backup failed. Nobody was alerted.
The backup failed, but nobody was alerted.
The backup failed, and nobody was alerted.
practice.hi: बैकअप विफल हुआ; किसी को सूचना नहीं मिली।
practice.feedback_en: Fix the comma splice with a semicolon, full stop or conjunction.
practice.feedback_hi: Comma splice को semicolon, full stop या conjunction से ठीक करें।

practice.prompt: Which punctuation goes before a list? 'Three accounts were affected ___ admin, backup and deploy.'
practice.hi: सूची से पहले कौन-सा चिह्न?
practice.feedback_hi: Colon सूची शुरू करता है।

practice.prompt: Because the token never expires.
answer: The issue is critical because the token never expires.
This is critical because the token never expires.
practice.hi: यह समस्या गंभीर है क्योंकि टोकन कभी एक्सपायर नहीं होता।
practice.feedback_en: A fragment: attach the 'because' clause to a main clause.
practice.feedback_hi: Fragment: 'because' clause को मुख्य clause से जोड़ें।

practice.prompt: Which list is parallel?
options: Rotate keys, enabling MFA, and logs should be reviewed.
Rotate keys, enable MFA, and review logs.
Rotating keys, enable MFA, and to review logs.
Keys rotation, enable MFA, reviewing logs.
answer: Rotate keys, enable MFA, and review logs.
practice.hi: कौन-सी सूची समानांतर है?
practice.feedback_en: All three items are bare verbs.
practice.feedback_hi: तीनों आइटम मूल क्रिया हैं।

practice.prompt: 'The fix was deployed; however, the alerts continued.' is correctly punctuated.
practice.hi: 'The fix was deployed; however, the alerts continued.' सही है?
practice.feedback_hi: सही: semicolon + however + कॉमा।

practice.prompt: We scanned the network and we found an open port and we reported it and it was closed.
answer: We scanned the network and found an open port. We reported it, and it was closed.
We scanned the network, found an open port and reported it. It was closed.
practice.hi: हमने नेटवर्क स्कैन किया और एक खुला पोर्ट पाया। हमने रिपोर्ट किया, और वह बंद कर दिया गया।
practice.feedback_en: Break the 'and' chain into two sentences.
practice.feedback_hi: 'and' की श्रृंखला को दो वाक्यों में तोड़ें।

practice.prompt: The root cause was clear ___ the config file had world-readable permissions. (punctuation)
practice.hi: मूल कारण स्पष्ट था: config फ़ाइल की permissions सबके लिए पढ़ने योग्य थीं।
practice.feedback_hi: व्याख्या से पहले colon।

practice.prompt: Which is why we rate this finding as high severity.
answer: This is why we rate this finding as high severity.
For this reason, we rate this finding as high severity.
practice.hi: इसी कारण हम इस निष्कर्ष को उच्च गंभीरता देते हैं।
practice.feedback_en: Fragment starting with 'Which'; use 'This is why'.
practice.feedback_hi: 'Which' से शुरू fragment; 'This is why' लगाएँ।

practice.prompt: Put the words in order (one sentence with a colon).
answer: Two hosts were affected: web01 and db01.
practice.hi: दो होस्ट प्रभावित हुए: web01 और db01।
practice.feedback_hi: कथन + colon + सूची।

practice.prompt: Choose the best-structured sentence for a report.
options: Although the patch was applied but the server still crashed, so we rolled back.
Although the patch was applied, the server still crashed, so we rolled back.
The patch was applied although the server crashed still, we rolled back.
Patch applied, server crashed, rolled back.
answer: Although the patch was applied, the server still crashed, so we rolled back.
practice.hi: रिपोर्ट के लिए सबसे अच्छा वाक्य चुनें।
practice.feedback_en: One 'although', comma after the intro clause, 'so' joins the result.
practice.feedback_hi: एक 'although', परिचय clause के बाद कॉमा, 'so' नतीजा जोड़ता है।

production.task_en: Write the 'Summary' section of a security finding in exactly 4 sentences: one using a colon before a list, one using a semicolon, one 'Although…' sentence, and a parallel 'We recommend X, Y and Z' sentence. No comma splices.
production.task_hi: किसी सिक्योरिटी निष्कर्ष का 'Summary' खंड ठीक 4 वाक्यों में लिखें: एक में सूची से पहले colon, एक में semicolon, एक 'Although…' वाक्य, और एक समानांतर 'We recommend X, Y and Z' वाक्य। कोई comma splice नहीं।
